name: Trust navy
summary: Deep navy with a warm amber accent. Reads as stable and credible.
guidance: Blue is the most common color for finance and enterprise software because it signals stability. A warm accent keeps it from feeling cold.
Body text needs 4.5:1 against its background; large text and UI outlines need 3:1.
Use primary-text only on primary fills. Do not place text-secondary on primary or accent.
Never rely on color alone to show state (for example error versus success); add an icon or text.
